description: This file defines a MediatR pipeline behavior for managing database transactions within requests. It wraps request handling with transaction begin, commit, and rollback logic using a ConduitContext.

classes.name: DBContextTransactionPipelineBehavior
classes.description: A pipeline behavior for handling database transactions around MediatR request processing.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Executes the request within a database transaction, committing on success and rolling back on exception.
